problem_1.title: Lack of Business Visibility
problem_1.description: Owners cannot view business performance across locations in one place.

problem_2.title: Inventory Leakage
problem_2.description: Businesses lose money because stock movement is not tracked accurately.

problem_3.title: Manual Reporting
problem_3.description: Managers spend hours preparing reports instead of managing operations.

problem_4.title: No Real Time Insights
problem_4.description: Decision makers receive information too late.

problem_5.title: Multi Outlet Complexity
problem_5.description: Comparing performance across outlets is difficult.

problem_6.title: Revenue Leakage
problem_6.description: Refunds, discounts, and operational inefficiencies reduce profitability.

problem_7.title: No Forecasting
problem_7.description: Businesses cannot predict demand or inventory requirements.

problem_8.title: Fragmented Systems
problem_8.description: POS, inventory, payments, and reporting exist in separate tools.

problem_9.title: Lack of Executive Reporting
problem_9.description: CEOs lack a single source of truth.

problem_10.title: Reactive Decision Making
problem_10.description: Organizations react to issues after losses occur.
